text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san! Thank you so much for sharing 
those movie tickets with me the other day!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Not at all. Those were just complimentary 
tickets we received from a client the 
Expedition Support Committee works with."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Judging by your expression, however, it 
seems you enjoyed yourself quite a bit. 
That is what matters most.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The team's bond in that movie was 
wonderful...! By the end, the whole 
theater came together, shouting "You can 
do it!"—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry. I just couldn't help it 
once I remembered."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That is fine. If I pass along your honest 
impressions... I'm sure they will be 
delighted as well.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, exactly! Journey-san, let's go watch 
it together next time!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"It's such a thrilling movie! 'Pre-Fi: The 
Movie'!"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
......I'm flattered by the invitation, 
but... To make you watch the exact same 
show twice would be...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please don't pay any mind to me.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No, I could watch it over and over! When 
you join in with all the kids in the 
audience, that movie really gives you so 
much energy."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
So since it's currently in theaters, it'd 
be a waste not to see it! Let's go 
together, Journey-san!
